Bingo Card Generator

Create printable 5×5 bingo cards with classic B-I-N-G-O number ranges, an optional free space, or your own custom word list.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick number mode or paste custom words.
  2. Toggle the free space on or off.
  3. Press New card, then Print for a clean paper copy.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Does it use standard bingo number ranges?

Yes — the classic ranges are used: B 1–15, I 16–30, N 31–45, G 46–60, O 61–75, with no repeats on a card.

Can I include a free space?

Leave the free-space box ticked for the classic center star, or untick it for a full 25-cell card.

Can I make bingo cards with words instead of numbers?

Choose the custom-words mode and paste up to 24 words — they are shuffled into the grid.

How do I print multiple cards?

Press New card as many times as you like, then use the Print button for a clean print layout.
